# Input

## Summary
The text input, with validation state and edge treatment as first-class args.

## Shape
`@state` (`none`, `valid`, `invalid`, `loading`, `initial`) drives the validation appearance and
pairs with `@errorMessage` and `@helperText`, so error presentation is the component's decision
rather than each form's. `@bottomTreatment` and `@topTreatment` let an input join a group
without a consumer overriding border radius by hand. `@type` covers the native variants,
`@onInput` yields the value directly while `@onChange`/`@onBlur`/`@onFocus` pass the event, and
`@min`/`@max`/`@autocomplete` forward to the element.

## Usage
Rendered in its states by the freestyle usage page at `packages/boxel-ui/src/components/input/usage.gts`.

```gts
import { BoxelInput } from '@cardstack/boxel-ui/components';
```
